steps.name: status
steps.note: Server.js /status. authFormData.authLoginCustomMessage is sanitize(null), which returns "" (empty string), not null. ConfigPath/MetadataPath only appear when isInit is false.

steps.name: login
steps.note: Auth.js handleLoginSuccess appends user.refreshToken then user.accessToken after the toOldJSONForBrowser keys. user.isOldToken is undefined (omitted). lastSeen is null because it is only set on socket.io auth (SocketAuthority.js); a pure-HTTP client never sets it - after any socket connect it becomes a ms number.

steps.name: login_cookie
steps.note: Without x-return-tokens: user.refreshToken is null and the refresh token is set as the refresh_token cookie instead.

steps.name: authorize
steps.note: MiscController.authorize -> Auth.getUserLoginResponsePayload: same as login but user has NO accessToken/refreshToken keys. isOldToken key appears (true) only if the request authenticated with the legacy non-expiring user.token; with the access token from login it is omitted.

steps.name: libraries_stats
steps.note: include=stats IS honoured (LibraryController.findAll) - adds library.stats {totalSize,totalDuration,numAudioFiles,totalItems}. totalSize sums libraryItems.size (all files incl. cover), not media.size.

steps.name: library
steps.note: Reply {filterdata, issues, numUserPlaylists, library}. filterdata also carries bookCount/authorCount/seriesCount/podcastCount/numIssues/loadedAt bookkeeping keys. Without include=filterdata the reply is just Library.toOldJSON.

steps.name: library_items
steps.note: sortBy and filterBy are undefined when sort/filter query params are absent, so those keys are omitted. include is "" (empty string). limit/page are numbers (middleware coerces). minified=1 has no effect on the item shape (always toOldJSONMinified).

steps.name: personalized
steps.note: Before any progress: recently-added, recent-series, discover, newest-authors (continue-listening/continue-reading/continue-series/listen-again/read-again need progress). Assumes book, series and author were created within the last 60 days (recently-added/recent-series/newest-authors filters). recent-series books are minified with authors=[] and series=[] so authorName/authorNameLF/seriesName are "". discover is randomly ordered. After progress exists a continue-listening shelf (type book, minified items) is prepended.

steps.name: search
steps.note: Only the title matches "time". book[] elements are {libraryItem: toOldJSONExpanded}. Non-matching groups are []. Element shapes when they do match: narrators {name,numBooks}; tags/genres {name,numItems}; series {series: Series.toOldJSON, books: [LibraryItem.toOldJSON() (full non-minified, media.authors=[] media.series=[])]}; authors Author.toOldJSONExpanded (+numBooks).

steps.name: authors
steps.note: Not paginated (no limit/page) -> {authors:[...]}; with ?limit=&page= the reply is {results,total,limit,page,sortDesc,minified,(sortBy/filterBy/include when given)}. Each author = toOldJSONExpanded(numBooks) + lastFirst.

steps.name: authors_paged
steps.note: LibraryController.getAuthors paginated branch: payload {results,total,limit,page,sortDesc,minified}; sortBy/filterBy/include are undefined (no query params) and therefore omitted. limit/page are numbers (LibraryController.middleware coerces). total = findAndCountAll count (distinct, books include required for non-admin). Each result = Author.toOldJSONExpanded(numBooks) + lastFirst.

steps.name: series
steps.note: QUIRK: with no ?limit the controller passes limit 0 / offset 0 straight to Sequelize findAndCountAll, which emits LIMIT 0, 0 -> results [] while total (separate COUNT) is 1. With ?limit=N each results[] element is Series.toOldJSON + books:[minified library items] (+totalDuration only when sort=totalDuration). sortBy/filterBy keys omitted when absent.

steps.name: series_paged
steps.note: seriesFilters.getFilteredSeries: each result = Series.toOldJSON + books[] (LibraryItem.toOldJSONMinified; book loaded with authors and series, so authorName/seriesName are populated - unlike the recent-series shelf). totalDuration only added when sort=totalDuration, rssFeed only with include=rssfeed. sortBy/filterBy omitted (undefined); include is "".

steps.name: filterdata
steps.note: Same object as library.filterdata (served from the Database.libraryFilterData cache for 30 min).

steps.name: narrators
steps.note: Narrator id is encodeURIComponent(base64(name)).

steps.name: author
steps.note: Author.toOldJSON (no numBooks) + libraryItems (minified). authorJson.series is only added when include also contains "series".

steps.name: series_one
steps.note: Route exists (deprecated, SeriesController.findOne). Plain Series.toOldJSON; progress/rssFeed only with ?include=progress / rssfeed. 404 if the user can access no book in the series.

steps.name: item
steps.note: userMediaProgress is null (no progress yet) and is appended after libraryFiles. media.ebookFile is the stored LibraryFile JSON + ebookFormat, so it also carries isSupplementary (null) and fileType ("ebook").

steps.name: play
steps.note: PlaybackSession.toJSONForClient: audioTracks are full audio-file objects + title/startOffset/contentUrl (Book.getTracklist, not objects/files/AudioTrack), libraryItem is toOldJSONExpanded, coverAspectRatio omitted (undefined). deviceInfo null keys are dropped; the client deviceName is ignored by DeviceInfo.setData (deviceName only derived from UA/model) and clientVersion falls back to the server version. Assumes no recognisable User-Agent (otherwise browserName/browserVersion/osName/osVersion/deviceType/deviceName appear). sessionId = id from this reply.

steps.name: sync
steps.note: res.sendStatus(200) -> text/plain "OK". Creates media progress (extraData.progress = session.progress = 120/duration) and persists the session (timeListening > 0).

steps.name: close
steps.note: Empty body -> syncData null -> saveSession only. res.sendStatus(200) -> "OK".

steps.name: progress_patch
steps.note: res.sendStatus(200) -> "OK". Because isFinished is present, MediaProgress.applyProgressUpdate skips the extraData.progress update, so the reported progress stays at the sync value (120/duration) while currentTime becomes 150.

steps.name: items_in_progress
steps.note: Minified library items + progressLastUpdate.

steps.name: listening_stats
steps.note: items[id] has no lastUpdate key (old PlaybackSession has no lastUpdate -> undefined, dropped). recentSessions are PlaybackSession.toJSON (no audioTracks/libraryItem); sessions read from the DB have chapters [] and deviceInfo rebuilt from the Device row. today/days depend on server date.

steps.name: local_all

mediaMetadata.title: The Time Machine
mediaMetadata.description: A Victorian scientist builds a machine that carries him into the far future.

steps.note: Reply {results:[{id,success,progressSynced}]}; failure entries are {id,success:false,error}. progressSynced is true only because the session updatedAt is newer than the progress updatedAt; progress then takes currentTime 200, progress 200/duration and updatedAt = session updatedAt.

steps.name: personalized_after
steps.note: Progress currentTime 200/3500.75, not finished, not hidden. Shelves in code order: continue-listening (type "book"; numTracks>0 so not continue-reading; total from findAndCountAll), recently-added, recent-series, newest-authors. continue-series absent (needs a finished book in the series), discover absent (the only book has currentTime>0 and its series counts as started), listen-again/read-again absent (nothing finished). Entities on continue-listening are plain minified items (no progress embedded).
